title: VEXON MED · AD #1 · Gym regular · Storyboard
music_note: Original instrumental score cut at 120 BPM (composed for this ad, royalty-free). Hits land on every section change.

shots.name: HOOK A
shots.note: Speed-ramped punch (1.5x into 0.5x). Hook beat 1 slams in line by line, then lifts away.

shots.name: HOOK B
shots.note: Whip pan follows the punch. Hook beat 2: AS A GYM REGULAR.

shots.name: PROBLEM a
shots.text: Working out consistently doesn’t mean every area of your performance is optimized.
shots.note: Motion-matched cut: same rowing stroke, front angle to side angle.

shots.name: PROBLEM b
shots.note: Zoom-blur push into the outdoor machine push. Line holds.

shots.name: STRENGTH
shots.note: Flash. Brackets lock onto the grip dynamometer.

shots.name: CARDIO
shots.note: Whip. Rings pulse from the VO2 mask.

shots.name: MOBILITY
shots.note: Paper cutout. Speed ramp into the bottom of the squat.

shots.name: BALANCE
shots.note: Vertical whip follows the squat down to the feet on the force plate.

shots.name: REACTION
shots.note: Hard cut with shake on the tap.

shots.name: QUESTION
shots.text: How do you actually measure up?
shots.note: Zoom punch into the 3D body scan. Slow pull-out, darker grade; music drops out.

shots.name: SOLUTION a
shots.text: Vexon Med goes beyond appearances to assess how your body performs.
shots.note: Flash on the drop. Body-composition assessment.

shots.name: SOLUTION b
shots.note: Panel drop to the decision-making results screen; scan line sweeps it.

shots.name: LOGO SLOT
shots.note: Soft fade to clean navy. Blank: client adds the logo.
